name: uiLevel
tip: The UI Level setting controls the level of settings that are exposed in the UI.  The default 'Basic' level exposes settings which are used by most users.  The 'Advanced' level provides additional settings to control most features within FPP.  'Experimental' is for experts only and exposes settings which may negatively affect system performance or cause issues if incorrectly used.  'Developer' is for developer and beta tester use.
